0022600017.text: The Brooklyn Nets, winless at 0-4 and on a four-game losing streak, host the Detroit Pistons (3-1, first in the Central and the East) in their fifth game of the 2026-27 season, an Emirates NBA Cup East Group A matchup. Brooklyn is 0-2 at home and 14th in the East, and Tyler Bilodeau is out with a shoulder sprain while Egor Demin is day-to-day with a leg bruise and is a game-time decision, with Detroit missing Jalen Duren, who is out with a hamstring strain. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Nets lost 1-3, including a 138-100 defeat in Brooklyn on March 10, 2026.
